pages.title: Source Code Fragment
pages.text: A few lines of the program that runs the universe. Mostly comments: notes, apologies, and an occasional reminder from someone to fix something later. The fragment glows like an old terminal screen and the text rearranges itself when I try to read it closely.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The Reality Compiler took a Bekenstein Crystal, a Cosmic Processor and a Boltzmann Brain and decompiled a patch of space. What came out was text. Most of it was comments, some of which seemed to refer to me.

Made in $(item)Reality Compiler$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Simulation Hypothesis.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Axiom Fragment, Cantor Diagonalizer, Dimensional Residue, Omega Point, Ontological Processor, Primordial Charter, Reality Anchor.
